name: Fujian Kuncai Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Kuncai Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of inorganic pigments in China and internationally. The company operates through Pearl materials and Titanium Dioxide segments. It offers pigments for applications in automotive coatings, plastics, cosmetics, printing inks, industrial coatings, consumer goods, seed coatings, papermaking, ceramics and glass, composites, personal care products, and other industries. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Fuzhou, China.
